exposure: combined low molecular weight heparin (LMWH) vitamin-K-antagonist anticoagulation regime
cohort: 52 women with prosthetic heart valves (PHV) for congenital heart disease who had a total of 102 pregnancies, with 78 pregnancies reaching ≥20 weeks gestation
finding: Pregnancies in women with mechanical PHV were associated with significantly higher rates of cardiovascular, obstetric, and fetal/neonatal complications compared to women with biological PHV, primarily due to PHV thrombosis and bleeding complications.
mod_finding: Women with mechanical PHV had a higher rate of cesarean sections compared to those with biological PHV.
birth_weight: Low birth weight and small for gestational age were assessed as outcomes
